d:
"Lau had a great trip planned to go to a hentai/anime convention in Japan. Even to the point of having a cosplay ready of “Prim Fiorire” from “Kuroinu Kedakaki Seijo wa Hakudaku ni Somaru” ready to go. But one little slip up on the plane and now Lau is somewhere else, and clearly enjoying herself fully years later. Seems this tribe of zebras are gonna have their hands full, and their balls empty. Either way, hope those tickets are still valid for the convention once she has a few more litters.~" - Commissioner
